dataset: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 held-out validation engines only; no official test labels used

policy.early_false_alarm_definition: first persistent alert when actual RUL exceeds the 30-cycle actionable horizon
policy.timely_detection_definition: first persistent alert at actual RUL 1 through 30 inclusive
policy.miss_definition: no alert in the actionable horizon, or alert only at failure (RUL 0)
policy.threshold_selection: maximize timely detection rate subject to at most 10% early false-alarm engines; ties choose the lower threshold
